versos.hebraico: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נִלְחֲמ֣וּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֑נָס אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃

controles.web: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
controles.kjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
controles.livre: Os filisteus guerrearam contra Israel; e os homens de Israel fugiram diante deles, e caíram feridos no monte de Gilboa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּדְבְּק֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל וְאַחֲרֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיַּכּ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים אֶת־יוֹנָתָ֧ן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָ֛ב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁ֖וּעַ בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃

controles.web: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
controles.kjv: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi–shua, the sons of Saul.
controles.livre: E os filisteus perseguiram a Saul e a seus filhos; e os filisteus mataram Jônatas, Abinadabe, e Malquisua, filhos de Saul.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּכְבַּ֤ד הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל־שָׁא֔וּל וַיִּמְצָאֻ֖הוּ הַמּוֹרִ֣ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת וַיָּ֖חֶל מִן־הַיּוֹרִֽים׃

controles.web: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
controles.kjv: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
controles.livre: E a batalha se dificultou sobre Saul; os flecheiros o alcançaram, e ele foi ferido pelos flecheiros.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁאוּל֩ אֶל־נֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜יו שְׁלֹ֥ף חַרְבְּךָ֣׀ וְדָקְרֵ֣נִי בָ֗הּ פֶּן־יָבֹ֜אוּ הָעֲרֵלִ֤ים הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִ֔י וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔יו כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א מְאֹ֑דס וַיִּקַּ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.”   But his armor bearer would not; for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell on it.
controles.kjv: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
controles.livre: Então Saul disse a seu escudeiro: Tira a tua espada, e atravessa-me com ela, para que não aconteça que estes incircuncisos venham, e escarneçam de mim.Porém seu escudeiro não quis, porque tinha muito medo. Então Saul tomou a espada, e se lançou sobre ela.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥רְא נֹשֵֽׂא־כֵלָ֖יו כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּפֹּ֥ל גַּם־ה֛וּא עַל־הַחֶ֖רֶב וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

controles.web: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died.
controles.kjv: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
controles.livre: E quando seu escudeiro viu que Saul estava morto, ele também se lançou sobre sua espada, e morreu.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤מָת שָׁאוּל֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֔יו וְכָל־בֵּית֖וֹ יַחְדָּ֥ו מֵֽתוּ׃

controles.web: So Saul died, and his three sons; and all his house died together.
controles.kjv: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
controles.livre: Assim Saul e seus três filhos morreram; e toda a sua casa morreu juntamente com ele.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יִּרְאוּ כָּל־אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־בָּעֵ֨מֶק֙ כִּ֣י נָ֔סוּ וְכִי־מֵ֖תוּ שָׁא֣וּל וּבָנָ֑יו וַיַּעַזְב֤וּ עָרֵיהֶם֙ וַיָּנֻ֔סוּ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
controles.kjv: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
controles.livre: E quando todos os homens de Israel que estavam no vale viram que o exército havia fugido, e que Saul e seus filhos estavam mortos, deixaram suas cidades, e fugiram; então os filisteus vieram, e habitaram nelas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְפַשֵּׁ֖ט אֶת־הַֽחֲלָלִ֑ים וַֽיִּמְצְא֤וּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו נֹפְלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃

controles.web: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
controles.livre: E no dia seguinte, quando os Filisteus vieram para despojar os mortos, acharam Saul e seus filhos estendidos no monte de Gilboa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨פְשִׁיטֻ֔הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת־כֵּלָ֑יו וַיְשַׁלְּח֨וּ בְאֶֽרֶץ־פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים סָבִ֗יב לְבַשֵּׂ֛ר אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־הָעָֽם׃

controles.web: They stripped him, and took his head, and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to their idols, and to the people.
controles.kjv: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
controles.livre: Então o despiram, tomaram sua cabeça e suas armas, e as enviaram por toda a terra dos filisteus para anunciarem a seus ídolos e ao povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּשִׂ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת־כֵּלָ֔יו בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֶת־גֻּלְגָּלְתּ֥וֹ תָקְע֖וּ בֵּ֥ית דָּגֽוֹן׃ס

controles.web: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
controles.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
controles.livre: E puseram suas armas no templo de seu deus, e colocaram sua cabeça no templo de Dagom.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֔וּ כֹּ֖ל יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְשָׁאֽוּל׃

controles.web: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
controles.kjv: And when all Jabesh–gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
controles.livre: E quando todos os de Jabes-Gileade ouviram tudo quanto filisteus haviam feito a Saul,

versos.hebraico: וַיָּקוּמוּ֮ כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ חַיִל֒ וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־גּוּפַ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְאֵת֙ גּוּפֹ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו וַיְבִיא֖וּם יָבֵ֑ישָׁה וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם תַּ֤חַת הָאֵלָה֙ בְּיָבֵ֔שׁ וַיָּצ֖וּמוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

controles.web: all the valiant men arose, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
controles.kjv: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
controles.livre: Todos os homens valentes se levantaram, tomaram o corpo de Saul e os corpos de seus filhos, e os trouxeram a Jabes; e sepultaram seus ossos debaixo de um carvalho em Jabes, e jejuaram durante sete dias.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁא֗וּל בְּמַֽעֲלוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעַ֣ל בַּֽיהוָ֔ה עַל־דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־שָׁמָ֑ר וְגַם־לִשְׁא֥וֹל בָּא֖וֹב לִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep; and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
controles.kjv: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
controles.livre: Assim Saul morreu por sua transgressão com que havia transgredido contra o SENHOR, por causa da palavra do SENHOR, a qual ele não obedeceu; e por ter buscado à médium para lhe consultar,

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־דָרַ֥שׁ בַּֽיהוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ וַיַּסֵּב֙ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָ֔ה לְדָוִ֖יד בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃פ

controles.web: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh: therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.
controles.kjv: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
controles.livre: E não ter buscado ao SENHOR. Por isso ele o matou, e passou o reino a Davi, filho de Jessé.
